defect.cause: resolveExtractedScope applied the complete public request schema to the nested extractor's partial goal object before using the already-valid outer request.
defect.previousVerificationGap: The previous acceptance covered normal scopes and real solver flows, but did not cover malformed/partial nested scope fields. Its passing test count did not establish this boundary.

behavior: Public requestScope remains strict: responses is required and nonempty; physical input validation is unchanged.
Internal scope fields are independently validated as advisory changes. Missing/empty responses cannot erase a valid outer request or accepted goal.
Known outer response families survive; additional valid response families are retained. Internal diagnostics are recorded without a tool failure or semantic retry.
When neither a valid declared scope nor an accepted/usable extracted response goal exists, retain geometry and loads and ask a localized requested-results question.
No invented default response family, stiffness, engine change, design conclusion or repeated extraction is used to repair optional metadata.

browserCases.note: The live provider actually emitted empty responses. The valid complete outer goal survived and the app asked for engineering inputs without a format error.
